defect: The fix only enriches the 'not suitable for replacement scans' error message with the object name, type and source location.
reason: An error-message improvement is a feature, not a repair of a defect introduced by moving the external dependency into the TableFunctionRef.

defect: The fix avoids dereferencing DistinctStatistics for unsupported (nested) column types in VACUUM/ANALYZE local and global states and in Combine.
reason: The change only adapted the Combine signature to OperatorSinkCombineInput; the unconditional Merge over all columns and the stats allocation existed before.

defect: The added early return tests get.table_filters.filters.empty() instead of !empty(), so filters are dropped/never pushed into a GET without table filters, contradicting its own comment.
reason: The fix inverts exactly the condition this change added.

defect: The fix restores the whole file to its pre-change blob (inline default order/null order, HAVING placement, removed DEBUG check), undoing the author's branch edits rather than repairing ResolveOrder/ResolveNullOrder.
reason: ResolveOrder and ResolveNullOrder are correct; the fix is a wholesale file revert in an unrelated branch, not a repair of a defect in these lines.

defect: In the filter path the result vector is indexed with the file column id (reader_data.column_ids[id]) instead of the local position id, so filtered columns are read into the wrong output vector.
reason: The fix changes result.data[local_col_id] back to result.data[id], matching the col_idx indexing this same change used in the other loops.

defect: Capping the cumulative chunk_count percentage at 100 while relying on bind_data.cur_file, which is never updated, makes multi-file Parquet progress stall at 100/n percent.
reason: Before the change the uncapped cumulative fraction roughly tracked multi-file progress; the fix (#11071, multi-file progress) replaces the stale cur_file in the changed formula with the global file_index.

defect: AppendData keeps dictionary_offset in a local and writes it to the block only after the loop, while RemainingSpace(handle) reads the stale stored offset, so the overflow decision uses wrong free space and the dictionary can overrun the vectors.
reason: The fix moves the load and SetDictionaryOffset into the per-string loop so RemainingSpace sees the current offset.

defect: The fix renames the declared CompareVal to CompareValAndAdvance in the header.
reason: A rename of a declaration is a refactor; no defect lies in this header line.

defect: The commit registers the 'recurring.<cte>' CTE reference only in the right binder but makes bind_basetableref look up cte_references['recurring.<cte>'], so referencing recurring.tbl from another CTE of a MATERIALIZED USING KEY CTE dereferences a null shared_ptr.
reason: Before this commit the lookup used the plain table name and existed; the fix adds the null check and folds the recurring binding into AddCTEBinding.

defect: The named-parameter check uses entry != end, so every valid named argument is rejected and unknown ones are accepted.
reason: The fix inverts exactly this added condition to entry == end.

defect: The new ParserException messages pass idx_t (64-bit) line numbers to the varargs formatter with %d specifiers, which is undefined behaviour and prints wrong values (and can misread the following %s argument).
reason: The fix changes exactly these added %d specifiers to %llu.

defect: The fix slices the COALESCE result by the incoming selection vector so COALESCE works under AND/OR with a selection.
reason: The original COALESCE executed children with the dense (sel, count) layout; the sel-indexed result positions that need the final Slice were introduced by the intermediate commit b516ba2 (short-circuit rewrite), not by this change.

defect: Set() discards the explicitly set paths and keeps only the expanded list (temp, set paths, main, pg_catalog), so current_setting('search_path') reports the internal schemas instead of the value that was set (e.g. 'test,test2').
reason: The fix keeps set_paths in Set and makes SearchPathSetting::GetSetting report only them, as the search_path test expects.

defect: The fix drops the now unused last_value member and adds set_paths with a GetSetPaths accessor.
reason: The defect fixed (reporting the expanded search path) came from the later Set/SetPaths rewrite, not from the original class declaration.

defect: The fix deletes the (by then rewritten) BaseScanner::Reset member.
reason: Removing an unused method is a cleanup, not a repair of a defect from this WIP skeleton.

defect: The fix reworks how skip_rows is chosen when skip_rows is set by the user combined with null_padding/ignore_errors and dirty notes.
reason: This change only replaced options.ignore_errors with options.ignore_errors.GetValue(); the skip_rows logic it touched was already there.

defect: The fix adds an explicit static_cast<double> to max_columns_found in the 70 percent comparison.
reason: idx_t times 0.7 is already evaluated in double, so the fix only silences an implicit-conversion warning without changing behaviour.

defect: The fix changes TryAbsOperator::Operation<TB, TB> to <TR, TR> in LCMOperator.
reason: Every registered lcm overload has TB equal to TR, so the wrong template argument has no observable effect; the fix is a type-correctness cleanup.

defect: The fix initializes InsertStatement::schema to DEFAULT_SCHEMA.
reason: When this was written DEFAULT_SCHEMA was the empty string, so the default-constructed schema was correct; the initialization became necessary only after DEFAULT_SCHEMA was renamed to 'main'.

defect: The fix initializes BaseTableRef::schema_name to DEFAULT_SCHEMA.
reason: The rename kept the existing default; it became wrong only when DEFAULT_SCHEMA changed from '' to 'main' in a later commit.

defect: AppendToBlock compares the byte offset of variable-size entries against block_capacity, which is an entry count, instead of block_capacity * entry_size, so blocks are treated as far smaller than allocated.
reason: The fix multiplies block_capacity by entry_size in exactly this added condition.

defect: The fix removes the special case that treated VARCHAR to BLOB casts as a no-op reference.
reason: BLOB was stored as VARCHAR and Value::BLOB did no conversion either, so the no-op gave consistent results; its removal in the work-in-progress BLOB feature is a design change, not a repair of a demonstrable defect.

defect: The fix wraps the returned unique_ptr<TYPE> in unique_ptr_cast<TYPE, BaseSecret> to fix a Linux compile error.
reason: The 'auto result = make_uniq<TYPE>' / 'return result;' pattern already existed before this change, which only renamed the class and added redact_keys deserialization.

defect: The fix turns the debug-only D_ASSERTs on argument count and list type into BinderExceptions.
reason: Unchecked non-list or wrong-arity input in release builds was already only asserted before; this change merely widened the assertion to allow SQLNULL.

defect: The fix reorders the constructor initializer list to count, start.
reason: At this change the members were declared start then count, matching the initializer; the mismatch came from the later commit that made start private and moved it after count.

defect: Prefix::Reduce sets the remaining byte count to PREFIX_SIZE - n - 1, assuming the prefix node is full, so a partially filled prefix gets a wrong count.
reason: The fix replaces that assignment with count -= n + 1 in the Reduce function this change implemented.

defect: The fix corrects LIST validity serialization and moves validity deserialization in the row format for multi-column ORDER BY sub-sorting.
reason: The WIP deserialize code of this change was rewritten long before; only a template line and braces still blame to it, and the repaired logic came from later commits.

defect: In the lines from this change the fix only renames total_size to payload_size; its real repairs (SubSortTiedTuples range, temp block unregister, early stop) are elsewhere.
reason: The payload size computation this change added is correct; renaming it is not a defect repair.

defect: vdata.validity.SetAllValid(count) on a default ValidityMask allocates a STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE buffer and then writes count bits, overflowing it when a nested list column appends more than 2048 child entries.
reason: The same-day fix removes exactly this added call, relying on the default all-valid mask instead.

defect: In this header the fix only renames the setting to 'pandas_analyze_sample' and the member to sample_size.
reason: The setting name was consistent with its registration in pyconnection.cpp, so the header change is a rename; the fixed bugs (can_convert flag, zero sample size) are in pandas_analyzer.cpp and partly predate this change.

defect: The fix makes ConjunctionFilter::Equals take const TableFilter& so it overrides TableFilter::Equals, and drops the pragmas.
reason: The non-overriding Equals overload already existed (from e7d2f79); this change only silenced the -Woverloaded-virtual warning that pointed at it.

defect: Changing ConjunctionOr/AndFilter::Equals from (const TableFilter&) to (const ConjunctionFilter&) stops them overriding TableFilter::Equals, so comparing filters through TableFilter falls back to the base type-only comparison.
reason: The fix restores the const TableFilter& signature on exactly these methods.

defect: The fix passes the parent binder to the subquery binder so CTEs of the outer query can be bound inside subqueries.
reason: CTE support did not exist when this change only renamed context to bind_context; the missing parent link became a defect with the later CTE feature.

defect: The fix extends the list of TPC-DS queries expected to compile.
reason: Both the change and the fix only edit a test's query list.

defect: The fix makes required_memory signed so the comparisons required_memory > 0 and < 0 work.
reason: In this change the unsigned difference was guarded by total_size > memory_usage and the else branch relied on modular addition, which is correct; the broken sign comparisons were added by the intermediate commit 5ffbe92.

defect: The fix recomputes stmt_location/stmt_length and the per-statement query text for the PEG parser.
reason: This change only reformatted the existing stmt_length line; the wrong length/offset logic predates it.

defect: The fix caches AllSecrets in the global state instead of calling it on every function invocation.
reason: AllSecrets was already called per invocation before; this change only switched to SecretManager::Get(context).

defect: The fix removes a misplaced appender.Flush() call from a test.
reason: Both the change and the fix are test edits.

defect: The fix widens TransformStandardAssignment's return type to SetStatement so SET x = DEFAULT can return a ResetVariableStatement.
reason: SET ... = DEFAULT was never handled by this transformer; the fix adds that support rather than repairing the narrowed return type.

defect: The fix changes the return type to SetStatement and maps a DEFAULT value to a ResetVariableStatement.
reason: This change only reformatted the function signature; the missing DEFAULT handling predates it.
